svg.aria-label: Warning time by distance: none at 20 and 50 km, about 10 s at 100 km, 38 s at 200 km, 67 s at 300 km

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: The shaking travels about 3.5 km/s. The alert reached a test phone 18.8 s after the quake began.
